scripts.build:next: npm run bundles && KITE_RUNTIME=node next build
scripts.test: npm run test:app && npm run test:relay
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:relay && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:worker
scripts.upload: npm run build && wrangler versions upload
scripts.bundles: npm run db:bundle && npm run changelog:bundle
scripts.build:node: npm run bundles && KITE_RUNTIME=node next build && node scripts/build-server.mjs
scripts.dev:node: npm run bundles && node scripts/build-server.mjs && KITE_RUNTIME=node node dist/server.mjs
scripts.setup:mission: npm ci && npm run bundles && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:app && npm run test:coverage:relay
scripts.demo:record: KITE_RECORD_DEMO=1 playwright test -c playwright.screenshots.config.ts scripts/screenshots/demo.capture.ts && node scripts/screenshots/encode-demo.mjs
scripts.test:list: playwright test --list && npm --workspace kite-email-relay run test:list

CF_TOKEN.description: Runtime Cloudflare API token Kite uses to manage DNS and Email Routing for your domains; Cloudflare's deploy token is not passed to the app. Create it under **Manage Account → Account API Tokens** with `DNS Edit`, `Zone Read`, `Zone Settings Edit` and `Email Routing Rules Edit` for the zones you will connect, plus account-level `Email Sending Edit` to send mail, and account-level `Workers R2 Storage Edit` and `Account API Tokens Edit` so setup can turn on direct Drive uploads (you may remove `Account API Tokens Edit` afterwards). Paste only the token secret, without `Bearer`. See [Deployment](https://github.com/midego1/kite/blob/main/docs/deployment.md#step-1-set-up-cf_token).

SETUP_TOKEN.description: A long random string of your own, at least 16 characters, for example from `openssl rand -hex 32`. Kite refuses the example value. Until the first admin account exists, setup only runs with it: open `/setup?setup_token=<value>` after the deploy.

APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: A long random string that encrypts the provider keys and webhook secrets Kite stores in D1, for example from `openssl rand -hex 32`. Replace the example value. Keep a copy: losing or changing it later makes those stored values unreadable.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key used to verify login and first-run registration challenges. Pair with NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY at build time.

NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Cloudflare Turnstile public site key used by the login and first-run registration widgets.

CF_EMAIL.description: Legacy Global API Key auth only. Use this with `CF_API_KEY` instead of `CF_TOKEN`.

CF_API_KEY.description: Legacy Global API Key auth only. Prefer `CF_TOKEN` for new deployments.
